content.text:
I submitted **index 27 (Sb fraction 0.8975)** as the best composition. It had the highest EQE I measured, 0.011%. Every reading on this line was very small, so treat the ranking as uncertain.

I used all 5 EQE measurements and 2 of the 5 XRD measurements:

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | 0.34 | −0.002 |
| 15 | 0.66 | 0.0023 |
| 19 | 0.76 | 0.0023 |
| 23 | 0.85 | 0.0067 |
| 27 | 0.90 | **0.011** |

- **Trend:** EQE was near zero on the Cu-rich side and rose steadily toward the Sb-rich end.
- **XRD:** The film at index 23 is mostly Sb₂O₄ (0.79 similarity to the simulated pattern), not CuSb₂O₆. Index 15, whose composition is close to CuSb₂O₆, was one of the weakest samples.

**What I didn't check:** I didn't measure index 28 (Sb 0.904), the last candidate on the line, because the budget ran out. The line could still peak there. I also didn't measure EQE anywhere between Sb 0.34 and 0.66, so a peak in that range can't be ruled out.
